title: Correlation-Aware Exploration for Long-Trace Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.34949v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning models trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) now produce chains of thought thousands of tokens long, and recent studies reveal that such training is prone to policy collapse. Entropy regularization is the standard remedy, but it works by pushing probability mass away from the few tokens that carry it and toward the vast low-probability tail of the vocabulary, and it applies this force once for every token of the reasoning trace. This puts the bonus in direct conflict with the entropy decay that convergence requires, and makes its coefficient difficult to set in the long-trace regime. To resolve this tension, we propose Info-GRPO, an information-theoretic framework that cultivates correlation between the policy and a latent prior. translated_title: 面向长链推理的相关性感知探索
translated_abstract: 使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练的推理模型如今能生成数千词元长度的思维链，而近期研究表明这类训练容易发生策略崩溃。熵正则化是标准的应对方法，但它通过将概率质量从少数承载概率的词元推向词汇表中庞大的低概率尾部来发挥作用，并且对推理轨迹中的每个词元都施加一次这种力。这使得该奖励项与收敛所需的熵衰减直接冲突，并使其系数在长轨迹场景下难以设定。为解决这一矛盾，我们提出Info-GRPO，一个旨在培养策略与潜在先验之间相关性的信息论框架。Info-GRPO并非处处提升熵，而是建立在潜在变量与其诱导轨迹之间的互信息之上：在训练过程中用潜在种子增强提示词……
tldr: 提出Info-GRPO信息论框架，通过培养策略与潜在先验之间的互信息相关性来解决GRPO长链推理训练中的策略崩溃问题，避免了熵正则化与收敛所需熵衰减之间的冲突。
en_tdlr: Info-GRPO, an information-theoretic framework that cultivates mutual information between the policy and a latent prior, resolves policy collapse in long-trace GRPO training without conflicting with the entropy decay required for convergence.
